DESIGN.current_hypothesis: Relevant explanations improve exact agreement more than absent or shuffled explanations.
key_evidence: Precommitted: 16 NLI + 16 QA examples; both requested target IDs; reciprocal other-model proxy; independent stateless paired calls; temperature 0; original + counterfactual target calls; no/true/shuffled explanation proxy calls.
Target receives identical task instructions on original and counterfactual; explanation never sees the counterfactual before generation.
Proxy sees original input/prediction and specified counterfactual input, target identity and output conventions, plus explanation only in explanation conditions.
Primary metric: within-item change in exact target-output agreement, with paired bootstrap CI and exact McNemar test; task/model strata reported separately.
QA normalization follows SQuAD punctuation/article/whitespace rules; NLI exact labels.
Shuffled explanation is next item in fixed cyclic task order; no outcomes used to select it.
Two repeated counterfactual targets per task/model for a small stability check.
main_risk: Small convenience sample; proxy ceiling; different target/proxy pairs confound between-target comparisons; no human participants; edit validity requires audit.
